name: All-Over Print V-neck Pet Jersey
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from lightweight and durable 100% polyester fabric.
    - Soft, breathable material helps keep pets comfortable during daily wear.
    - Features a sporty V-neck design and sleeveless cut for easy movement.
    - Soft-trimmed neckline, armholes, and hem provide a smooth, comfortable finish.
    - Suitable for dogs of various breeds and body sizes.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in sizes XS–5XL.
    📌 Note: Due to manual measurement, there may be an error of 1–3 cm.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Vibrant all-over sublimation print: With full-color sublimation, your designs stay bold, fade-resistant, and eye-catching.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Provides a comfortable and sporty outfit for pets.
    - Sleeveless construction allows natural walking, running, and playing.
    - V-neck opening makes the jersey easy to put on and remove.
    - Lightweight fabric is suitable for indoor and outdoor activities.
    - Ideal for daily walks, pet parties, photoshoots, sporting events, and family gatherings.
    - Can be personalized with your pet’s name, number, or favorite theme.
    - Easy to coordinate with matching family, team, or holiday outfits.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect for pet birthdays, adoption anniversaries, and gotcha-day celebrations.
    - Great for Christmas, Halloween, Thanksgiving, and other seasonal holidays.
    - Ideal for sports events, family reunions, parties, and pet photoshoots.
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for dog owners, pet lovers, friends, and family members.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3 – 5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x All-Over Print V-neck Pet Jersey

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 1-3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as an .emb, .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
